blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Environmental groups and various organizations in Marinduque are seeking help from the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) for the release of the $100 million rehabilitation fund from Marcopper mine disaster settlement. This is in relation to the 2025 settlement agreement entered into by the people of Marinduque and Canadian firm Barrick Gold.
